name: Arbaal the Undefeated
canonNotes: A champion of Khorne granted the axe called the Destroyer for his devotion, undefeated for over three thousand years.
Khorne watches him without mercy; one failure would cost him everything, so he never allows one.
voiceNotes: Terse, relentless and certain of victory; talks only of battle.
Scorns any hint of weakness, including mercy or negotiation.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
